name: Serious Goose 17
author: Smit-Prajapati
description: Neon gradient rounded amber text input that glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background changes from linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd43b 0%, #ff6600 100%) to linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd43b 50%, #ff6600 100%), box-shadow becomes 0px 0px 100px #ffd43b, 0px 0px 100px #ff6600. On focus, border becomes 1px solid #FFD43B, the outline is removed, box-shadow becomes inset 0px 0px 10px #ff6600, inset 0px 0px 10px #ffd43b, 0px 0px 100px #ffd43b, 0px 0px 100px #ff6600.
